name: Chatwrap
description: Chatwrap analyses your WhatsApp conversations and turns them into an animated retrospective, 100% in your browser.

description_localized.fr: Chatwrap analyse tes conversations WhatsApp et en fait une rétrospective animée, 100% dans ton navigateur.
description_localized.es: Chatwrap analiza tus conversaciones de WhatsApp y las convierte en una retrospectiva animada, 100% en tu navegador.
description_localized.de: Chatwrap analysiert deine WhatsApp-Chats und macht daraus eine animierte Rückschau, zu 100% in deinem Browser.
description_localized.pt: O Chatwrap analisa as tuas conversas do WhatsApp e transforma-as numa retrospetiva animada, 100% no teu navegador.
description_localized.it: Chatwrap analizza le tue chat di WhatsApp e le trasforma in una retrospettiva animata, al 100% nel tuo browser.
description_localized.nl: Chatwrap analyseert je WhatsApp-gesprekken en maakt er een geanimeerde terugblik van, 100% in je browser.
description_localized.id: Chatwrap menganalisis percakapan WhatsApp kamu dan mengubahnya menjadi retrospeksi animasi, 100% di peramban kamu.
description_localized.tr: Chatwrap WhatsApp sohbetlerini analiz eder ve onlardan animasyonlu bir geriye bakış oluşturur, %100 tarayıcında.
